name: audiophonics_evo_sabre
description: The EVO Sabre's second display and its remote control
author: Just a Nerd

volumio_info.details: Drives the EVO Sabre's second OLED display (the track, its format, level meters, the time played at a size you choose, a clock or a snake while the player rests) and the transport keys of its remote control, and can hold the audio output open so the DAC's clocks never stop between tracks. One small native program runs the display and the remote; nothing is compiled on the player and no remote-control daemon is installed.
volumio_info.changelog: 3.1.1 A choice of digits for the Extra large track time: segments, light or bold. Restart the player after updating.
